Só Living offers stunning 1 and 2-bedroom apartments in the heart of Dublin City Centre. All apartments come fully furnished with custom designed interiors and a wide range of amenities including fully equipped gym and business centre.

Só Living provides a rental service of the highest quality through our on-site management office. Our dedicated team are available to make your rental and living experience with Só Living as seamless and as comfortable as possible. Through our parcel collection service we aim to provide the services that you really need.

Grand Canal Place is located on Boyne St., adjacent to Merrion Square and in the Grand Canal Docks. No matter where you need to be in Dublin City, our central locations mean your Só Living development is never too far away.

To fully appreciate the uniqueness of what we offer, viewing is highly advised. Contact a member of our team today to arrange a personal viewing and see for yourself!
